description: Compose a one-folder handoff/portfolio documentation PACKAGE for a network: a README.md (title, node count, per-family summary, how-to-load note), a topology.md with a Mermaid graph of the connections, and - when include_thumbnails is set - preview PNGs of output TOPs under thumbs/ linked from gallery.md, all written into out_dir. Unlike generate_readme (a single file), this assembles a small multi-file site folder for sharing or archiving a project.

include_thumbnails.description: Capture preview PNGs of output TOPs into thumbs/ and link them in gallery.md.

max_thumbnails.description: Maximum number of output-TOP previews to capture when include_thumbnails is set.

out_dir.description: Folder to write the documentation package into (relative or absolute).

parent_path.description: The network to document (project or COMP), e.g. /project1 or /project1/myComp.

title.description: Document title. Defaults to the basename of parent_path when blank.

name: project_documentation_site
title: Project documentation site
